meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成代码改动的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需要向团队解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Generate explainer videos from code changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to your team

howto.what: 收到 GitHub PR 后，Claude 读取其 diff、提交与文件，按 storyboard、脚本、分帧、渲染的顺序生成代码变更讲解视频，产出 STORYBOARD.md、SCRIPT.md 与 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当用户给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#编号或已检出仓库里的“this PR”等代码变更输入时触发；不处理网站或产品宣传，意图不明转 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#123 做成讲解视频
say.note: 会先产出 storyboard 提案供确认。

say.text: 用 owner/repo#42 做功能上新讲解
say.note: 按 feature-reveal 骨架生成脚本并渲染。

say.text: 基于当前仓库的 this PR 做重构讲解
say.note: 直接使用已检出仓库的 PR 数据。

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub pull request (diff, commits, files) into a code-change explainer video via storyboard → script → frames → render, outputting STORYBOARD.md, SCRIPT.md, compositions/frames, and renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a PR URL, an owner/repo#N ref, or “this PR” in a checked-out repo — a code-change input, not a website; unclear intent routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn owner/repo#123 into an explainer video.
say_en.note: It reads the PR and proposes a storyboard first.

say_en.text: Make a feature-reveal video for owner/repo#42.
say_en.note: Script follows the feature-reveal archetype and renders.

say_en.text: Use this PR in the current repo to make a refactor walkthrough.
say_en.note: Uses the checked-out repo's PR data.
